exposure: Maternal diabetes (Gestational Diabetes Mellitus, pre-Gestational Diabetes Mellitus)
outcome: Perinatal morbidity (hypoglycaemia, large for gestational age, hypocalcaemia, hyperbilirubinemia, polycythaemia, congenital anomalies, birth injuries)
cohort: The cohort consists of 100 infants born to diabetic mothers (IDMs) who were admitted to the neonatal care unit in a tertiary hospital.
finding: The study found a high incidence of neonatal complications in infants of diabetic mothers, including hypoglycemia (60%), hypocalcaemia (45%), hyperbilirubinemia (43%), polycythaemia (62%), and a 10% mortality rate.
gest_age: 23.75% of neonates were Large for Gestational Age.
